# Draft:Dargah Hazrat ilaihi Shah Warsi Rahmatullah

----
Hazrat Muhammad Ilahi Shah Warsi (RA)
Mukhtasir Taaruf: Hazrat Muhammad Ilahi Shah Warsi (RA) ek buzurg aur roohani rehnuma the jo silsila-e-Warsiya se taalluq rakhte the. Aap ka asal marakaz Allahabad mein tha jahan aap ki dargah Narula Road, Buddha Tajiya ke paas waqe hai. Aap Hazrat Waris Ali Shah (RA) ke khulafa mein se ek azeem naam ke taur par mashhoor hain. Aap ki wafat 1919 mein hui.
Wiladat aur Nasab: Hazrat Ilahi Shah Warsi (RA) ka paidaish ka saal daqiq tor par maloom nahin lekin aap 19vi sadi ke aakhir mein ek roohani gharane mein paida huay. Aap ka taluq ek aise parivaar se tha jo deen aur tasawwuf se gehra lagao rakhta tha.
Taleem-o-Tarbiyat: Aap ne apni ibtidaai taleem apne ilaqay mein hasil ki. Qur'an, Hadith, Fiqh aur Tasawwuf mein maharaat haasil ki. Baad mein aap ne Hazrat Waris Ali Shah (RA) se roohani nisbat hasil ki aur unke mukhlis mureed ban gaye.
Roohani Nisbat: Hazrat Ilahi Shah Warsi (RA) ne Warsi silsila mein kamal hasil kiya. Aap Hazrat Waris Pak (RA) ke aqidatmand aur chahite mureed the. Waris Pak ne aap ko apna khalifa manzoor farmaya. Dargah ke board aur riwayaton ke mutabiq, Hazrat Ilahi Shah Warsi ko khilafat ka sanad diya gaya tha.
Waris Pak ka Call (Ijazatnama): Ek roohani riwayat ke mutabiq, Hazrat Waris Ali Shah (RA) ne Hazrat Ilahi Shah Warsi (RA) se farmaya: “Ilahi Shah, Allahabad tumhare hawale kar diya.” Yeh jumla sirf khilafat ka izhar nahi, balki Allahabad mein silsila-e-Warsiya ki roohani nigrani ki ijazat thi. Aaj bhi dargah ke mutawalli aur mureed is call ko haqiqi roohani ijazat samajhte hain. Unka aqeeda hai ke Ilahi Shah Warsi hi Allahabad ke wahid aur mukhtasir khalifa the Hazrat Waris Pak ke.
Taleemat aur Asraat: Aap ki talimat mein mohabbat, wahdat, sabr aur ikhlas ki buniyad par zindagi guzarne ka paighaam tha. Aap ne shariat par mazbooti se amal karte huay logon ko roohani sulook ka raasta dikhaya. Aap ki baatein logon ke dil par gehra asar karti thin. Aap ki mehfilon mein ilmi aur roohani nizam barqarar rehta tha.
Mureedeen: Aap ke mureedeen mein har tabqay ke log shamil the. Allahabad aur aas paas ke ilaqon mein aap ki roohani tasir ab tak mehsoos ki ja sakti hai. Aap ke silsila ko aage barhane wale murideen ne aap ke paighaam ko dusron tak pahunchaaya.
Khulafa: Hazrat Ilahi Shah Warsi (RA) ke kuch muktar khulafa ne silsila ko aage barhaya. Unka zikar local zubani riwayaton mein milta hai. Unke naam tahriri tor par darj karne ke liye tahqiqat jari hai.
Wafat aur Dargah: Aap ka visal 1919 mein hua. Aap ki dargah Allahabad ke Narula Road par waqe hai, jo roohaniat ka markaz bani hui hai. Har saal hazaron log ziyarat ke liye aate hain.
Aakhri Baat: Hazrat Ilahi Shah Warsi (RA) ne apni zindagi ko roohaniyat, khidmat-e-khalq, aur ishq-e-ilahi ke liye wakf kiya. Aaj bhi unki dargah par log roohani sukoon aur hidayat ke liye aate hain.
